design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (paycheck_advance_servicing). Step 0 draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5, 4]; the card repayment share takes 5 factors, the late-fee assessment takes 4.
SCOPE SNAPSHOT. Occupied by task 0: advance_ext_payroll_delay_relief (grant_payroll_delay_relief_50112cf3) and advance_ext_largest_advance (request_advance_00c9f515) — subjects advance_fee_waiver and advance_disbursement. Claimed here, disjoint: advance_ext_late_fee_assessment (agent, state_due, assess_late_fee_a649c20a, subject advance_fee) and advance_ext_card_repayment_share (user, on_request, repay_advance_by_card_db2e846d, subject advance_repayment). With this task the four extended policies are all claimed; nothing is left idle.
WHY A GOOD TEST. The customer only wants to pay what she owes on her overdue advance by bank debit card. On a past-due line the rule caps a card repayment at a share of what the line owes, built from five factors (track record, last month's payroll in the personal account, earlier debit-card repayments, plan, days past due), and that share is not applied until every closed late-fee period carries its late fee entry. The ledger shows the first period closed on 2026-10-17 with no late fee; the agent must work out from the late-fee rule that booking the late fee is the write that brings that state about, compute the fee (four factors: a payroll-based weekly rate, a collection credit, a plan factor and a first-period treatment) and only then compute the card repayment on the higher balance.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root advance_ext_card_repayment_share; edge -> advance_ext_late_fee_assessment, kind value_input, gate amount_owed, form state. Prerequisite sentence (card repayment rule): 'The card repayment share is not applied until the line carries a late fee entry for every late-fee period that has closed on its past-due advance.' Four-point test: (1) 'not ... until', the negated direction a collections desk uses for a payment it will not take yet — the contrapositive of 'applied only after the line carries ...'; task 0's sentence runs in the affirmative direction, so the charter carries both; (2) record-visible state (late fee entries per closed period); (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) 'every late-fee period that has closed', exactly the condition. Exactly one write of the difficulty books late fee entries: the late-fee assessment (the relief books waivers, the advance request books a flat fee, the repayment books a repayment). Derivation: sentence + ledger (advance e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a due 2026-09-30, 210.00 collected 45480a09-ad3d-4dc8-8d24-87576bb8de75, line past due since 2026-10-10, no late fee row) + late-fee rule ('When a full late-fee period has closed on the line's most recent advance after its grace period while that advance still has unpaid principal, the late fee of that period is booked ...') -> book period 1. False at frozen_time: grace ended 2026-10-10, 7-day block closed 2026-10-17, no row. Order: late fee (step 7) then repayment (step 9). No parallel edges. Deletion sensitivity (recomputed): without the late fee the repayment is 144.20, not 144.63.
CUSTOMER-OWNED WRITE. repay_advance_by_card_db2e846d is owner=user (blueprint: 'making a manual repayment from the customer's own funds ... the customer's own decisions'); it records repayment_method manual_debit_card because a personal-balance repayment fires a wallet internal debit (another category). The agent unlocks it at step 8 and she submits the amount the agent gives her.
FACTOR CARD — late fee (advance_ext_late_fee_assessment, 3 parameter + 1 method). Baseline: unpaid principal 206.00 x late_fee_pct_weekly 1.00 percent = 2.06, min 0.50, cap 16.00. steady_payroll_rate (cross wallet, multi-source): deposits after 2026-07-19 total 6490.00 >= 5400 AND no late fee ever -> 0.50 percent (baseline 1.25). collection_credit: 194.00 of 400.00 principal repaid, 48.5 percent -> x0.9 (near-miss: gross 210.00 = 52.5 percent would wrongly give x0.8; the flat fee took 16.00 first) (baseline 0.69). plan_factor (cross wallet): Prime -> x0.9 (baseline 0.69). first_period_treatment (method): period 1, line 714 days old -> x0.75 rounded down (baseline half-up 0.83). 206.00 x 0.005 x 0.9 x 0.9 = 0.8343 -> 0.62.
FACTOR CARD — card repayment (advance_ext_card_repayment_share, 4 parameter + 1 method). Baseline: owed 206.62 x standard_share 30 percent = 61.99. track_record (multi-source): 714 days (< 730) AND 4 advances (>= 3) -> +10 (baseline 123.97). payroll_points (cross wallet): 2026-09-30 210.00 + 2026-10-15 1160.00 = 1370.00 from 2 deposits, below 1800, at least 900 -> +5 (near-miss: the 480.00 reimbursement dated 2026-09-19 is on the excluded first day; including it gives 1850.00 and +15) (baseline 134.30). card_history: one earlier manual_debit_card repayment (2026-06-12); the 2026-07-29 personal-balance repayment does not count -> +5 (baseline 134.30). plan_points (cross wallet): Prime -> +10 (baseline 123.97). arrears_timing (method): three different computations by age of the arrears — at most 14 days past due: 2 points added per day short of 14; 15 to 30 days: share x1.1; later: share as it stands. 9 days -> 60 + 10 = 70 percent (baseline 123.97). 70 percent of 206.62 = 144.63.
OVERWRITES. Late fee: replaces the base late-fee amount sentence of advance_late_fees (rate, rounding, minimum, cap) with the factor-bearing rule whose baseline is the same formula; the grace, past-due and extension-protection sentences stay inherited. Card repayment: replaces the base manual-repayment sentence of advance_repayment_rules (any amount up to the whole) with the card repayment share on past-due lines; allocation fees first, the minimum and the on-time rule stay inherited. The rule restates the bounds that survive for every other manual repayment (personal balance, or a line not past due): at least min_manual_repayment or the whole amount outstanding, never more.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 7 (advance_fee): advance_fees, advance_late_fees and advance_extensions carry no structured gate for this subject (policy_scope): the advance is unpaid past grace, no extension defers the fee, the late fee is a charter fee. Step 9 (advance_repayment): advance_repayment_rules (policy_scope): Max supports external-card repayment; 144.63 is above min_manual_repayment 5.00 and below the 206.62 owed. No time gate applies; temporal_feasibility is empty.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target: advance e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a (the only advance with anything owed); its flat fee 16.00 and partial autopay 210.00 are correlated by source_txn_id; the older advances (2026-03-18, 2026-05-18, 2026-07-03) are repaid in full and excluded. The new late fee and the repayment both carry source_txn_id e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a.
WORLD ROWS. customers; wallet_accounts (Prime, opened 2024-08-19, balance 1160.00 = sum of the seeded activity, zero from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-15 so the autopay retries found nothing); 34 wallet_transactions (semi-monthly payroll 1160.00 with the short 210.00 of 2026-09-30, the 480.00 reimbursement of 2026-09-19, rent, Prime plan fees, cash-outs, the 2026-07-29 internal debit of the personal-balance repayment); advance_lines (Max, past_due since 2026-10-10, owed 206.00); 12 advance_ledger rows. No card is seeded (no card read is needed). Automatic clauses checked: no suspension (9 days < 45), no write-off, no courtesy request, the 2026-10-01 review kept Max (September deposits 1850.00 from 3), the payroll-delay relief is not due (the advance is not repaid, and its autopay deposit posted on the due date), no second late-fee period closed (2026-10-24).
PERSONA. Hollis Vandermeer, careful and slightly embarrassed; volunteers the surface goal (pay what she owes on the overdue advance by bank debit card, not from the Pocketwire balance) and her mobile number; says only what she saw in the app (past due); gives DOB and SSN last four when asked; the card on request; passive consent to anything recorded first; if told the card can take only part, pays the most allowed; submits the hand-over herself and ends on the confirmation. Never names a fee or a figure.
STANDARD SOLUTION. find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB, SSN4) -> find_advance_lines -> find_advance_ledger -> find_wallet_accounts -> find_wallet_transactions -> unlock + call assess_late_fee(line, e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a, 1, 0.62) -> unlock_user + customer calls repay_advance_by_card(line, e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a, 144.63).
VERIFICATION RUN (executed): check_compute --task 1 recomputes 0.62 at step 7 and 144.63 at step 9 (after the late fee); factor sensitivities as listed; all-baseline 2.06 and 61.99; skipping the late fee gives 144.20. Revision: check_compute/check_extended first failed because the collection_credit factor owned no record-reading binding (symptom: 'none of its bindings reads history'); root cause: the LATEST read of the advance principal sat outside the factor; change: advance_principal added to that factor's bindings; re-run: COMPUTE OK, EXTENDED OK. All other --task 1 gates OK; replay closure 49/49 rows.
CLOSURE. late fee -> assess_late_fee_a649c20a -> step 7 amount 0.62; card repayment share -> repay_advance_by_card_db2e846d -> step 9 amount 144.63; charter_scope and required_documents list both in resolution order. Difficulty-wide, tasks 0 and 1 cover the four extended policies with disjoint policies and tools.
DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. From the published card-repayment rule the agent learns the share is not applied until every closed late-fee period has its late fee entry; the ledger and line show the advance due 2026-09-30 past grace since 2026-10-10 and no late fee; the late-fee rule gives 206.00 x 0.50 percent x 0.9 x 0.9 x 0.75 rounded down = 0.62 for period 1; then (60 + 10) = 70 percent of 206.62 = 144.63. Same writes, order and values as gold.
ROUND 2 REVISION (policy-task audit r1). F-FAC-1 symptom: arrears_timing only swapped a multiplier (x1.2 / x1.1 / x1); change: the early tier now adds early_points_per_day points per day short of early_days (a per-day sliding scale), the middle tier multiplies by 1.1, the last uses the share as it stands — different formulas; re-run: repayment 148.77 -> 144.63 (skip-edge value 144.20), sensitivities 123.97/134.30/134.30/123.97/123.97, all-baseline 61.99. F-OBS-3: the late-fee rule now books a period only while the advance still has unpaid principal (compute returns 0 otherwise); this world's fee stays 0.62. F-OBS-7: the card-share rule restates the base bounds for every other manual repayment. Propagated to evaluation_criteria, computations, prerequisite_closure, solvability_contract and this dossier.
user_scenario: You are Hollis Vandermeer, 31, a respiratory therapist in Columbus, calling in the evening after a shift; you are polite, a little embarrassed and careful, and you take your time to be sure you understand. You explain that you took unpaid leave in September, so your end-of-month paycheck was tiny and your Pocketwire Advance is now overdue; you saw in the app that it says past due. You want to pay off what you owe on it today with your bank debit card, not from your Pocketwire balance, because that money is set aside for rent. To help them find you, you give your mobile number, 5552657719. You have only this one advance line and this one overdue advance; you do not know the exact amount owed and you ask the agent to look it up rather than guessing. You give identity details only when asked: your date of birth is 1995-02-27 and the last four of your Social Security number are 5904; your email is hollis.vandermeer@pw5mail.example if they ask for it. If the agent asks which card, it is your Buckeye State Credit Union debit card ending 5617, which you have used for a Pocketwire repayment before. If the agent tells you something has to be recorded on the account on their side first, you say that is fine and let them do it. If the agent tells you that only part of the balance can go on a debit card today, you say you will pay the most that is allowed today and let autopay or a later payment handle the rest; you never propose a figure of your own. Paying is your own decision, so when the agent hands the payment over to you, you make it yourself with exactly the amount the agent gives you and then read back the confirmation you get. Once you have that confirmation, you thank the agent and end the call; you do not raise anything else.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's customer profile from the mobile number she volunteers.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs her customer reference number; verification compares her stated details with this profile.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with three stated details (mobile number, date of birth, SSN last four).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account detail may be discussed and no fee or repayment booked before identity is verified; three matches are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read her line: Pocketwire Advance Max, status past_due since 2026-10-10, opened 2024-11-04, owed 206.00.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The tier gives grace_period_days 10, late_fee_interval_days 7, late_fee_pct_weekly, late_fee_min, the cap and dd_min_monthly 1800; the past-due date drives the days-past-due treatment; the opening date drives the first-period treatment and the track record.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the line's ledger: four advances with their flat fees, the repayments (one by autopay, one by debit card, one from the personal balance, and the partial autopay of 210.00 on 2026-09-30 against the 400.00 advance due that day) and no late fee.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is where the agent discovers the unmet prerequisite: the first late-fee period of the advance due 2026-09-30 (grace ended 2026-10-10) closed on 2026-10-17 and no late fee entry stands for it, which the card repayment share waits on. The rows also give the unpaid principal 206.00, the share already repaid (194 of 400), the never-before late-fee record, the advance count (4) and the single earlier debit-card repayment.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the linked personal account: plan Pocketwire Prime, active.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The plan decides the plan factor of the late fee and the plan points of the card repayment share.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the personal-account activity, in particular the direct deposits and their dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The three-month deposit total (6490.00 after 2026-07-19) decides the weekly late-fee rate; the last month's deposits (2026-09-30 and 2026-10-15, the 2026-09-19 reimbursement falling on the excluded first day) decide the payroll points.
First half of the unlock/call pair for the late fee; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the late fee of 0.62 for late-fee period 1 on the advance due 2026-09-30; the line then owes 206.62.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: advance_ext_late_fee_assessment computes the fee; the card repayment share is not applied until this late fee entry stands, and it raises what the line owes.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.advance_line_id: Value 1272fbe2-67f7-47ad-a6c3-9303717bbeef. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the customer's advance line, as returned by the advance line lookup'; the lookup returns her single line. Uniqueness: no other line exists for her.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_txn_id: Value e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a. Basis: the rule says 'the late fee of that period is booked on that advance', 'that advance' being 'the line's most recent advance'; the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the advance the late fee belongs to (its disbursement entry)'. The ledger's most recent disbursement is the 400.00 advance of 2026-09-02 due 2026-09-30, the only one not repaid. Uniqueness: the three older advances are repaid in full and have no closed late-fee period.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_period: Value 1. Basis: the rule says 'The periods are counted in whole late_fee_interval_days-day blocks from the day the grace period ends, which is grace_period_days calendar days after the advance's due date, and the period booked is the most recent block that has closed by the handling date.' Due 2026-09-30 + grace 10 = 2026-10-10; one full 7-day block closed on 2026-10-17 and the second closes 2026-10-24, after 2026-10-19. The docstring: '1 for the first full late-fee period after the grace period'. Uniqueness: no earlier late fee exists, so period 1 is the one due.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 0.62. unpaid principal 206.00; weekly rate 0.50 percent (6490.00 of deposits in three months >= 5400, no earlier late fee); collection factor 0.9 (194.00 of 400.00 principal repaid = 48.5 percent); plan factor 0.9 (Prime); 206.00 x 0.005 x 0.9 x 0.9 = 0.8343; first period on a line opened 714 days ago -> x 0.75 rounded down = 0.62; minimum 0.50 and cap 16.00 do not bind. Any agent applying the rule converges on 0.62; dropping a factor gives 1.25, 0.69 or 0.83.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's debit-card repayment and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A manual repayment from the customer's own card is her decision; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer repays 144.63 on the overdue advance from her external debit card; the line then owes 61.99.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: advance_ext_card_repayment_share computes the most a debit-card repayment may take today on the world after the late fee.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.advance_line_id: Value 1272fbe2-67f7-47ad-a6c3-9303717bbeef. Basis: docstring 'as returned by the advance line lookup'; her only line. Uniqueness: single line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_txn_id: Value e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the advance being repaid (its disbursement entry)'; she asks to pay what she owes on the overdue advance, and the only advance with anything owed is the one due 2026-09-30. Uniqueness: every other advance is repaid in full.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 144.63. Evaluated after the late fee of step 7: what the line owes 206.62; share 30 + track 10 (714 days, 4 advances) + payroll 5 (1370.00 from 2 deposits in the month) + card history 5 (one earlier debit-card repayment) + plan 10 (Prime) = 60; past due 9 days, at most early_days 14 -> early_points_per_day 2 points for each of the 5 days short of 14 = +10 -> 70 percent; 206.62 x 0.70 = 144.634 -> 144.63, above min_manual_repayment 5.00 and below 206.62. Without the late fee it would be 144.20, so the order is load-bearing.

factor_trace: steady_payroll_rate (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet, multi-source): direct deposits after 2026-07-19 up to 2026-10-19 total 6490.00 >= 3 x dd_min_monthly 1800 = 5400 AND the line has never carried a late fee -> steady_rate_first 0.50 percent; the baseline rate late_fee_pct_weekly 1.00 gives 1.25.

collection_credit (parameter): principal 400.00 less unpaid principal 206.00 = 194.00 repaid, share 0.485 -> at least collection_low_share 0.30 but below 0.50 -> factor 0.9 (near-miss: the gross 210.00 collected is 52.5 percent, but 16.00 of it covered the flat fee first); baseline factor 1 gives 0.69.
plan_factor (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): plan Pocketwire Prime -> plan_factor_member 0.9; baseline 1 gives 0.69.

first_period_treatment (method): period number int((19 days from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-19 - grace 10) / 7) = 1 and the line opened 2024-11-04, 714 days >= 365 -> the fee is multiplied by 0.75 and rounded down: 0.8343 x 0.75 = 0.6257 -> 0.62; the standard method rounds 0.8343 half up to 0.83.
unpaid_principal (plumbing): disbursed 1450.00 - MX(0, repaid 1302.00 + waived 0 - fees 58.00) = 206.00.
rated_fee = 206.00 x 0.50 / 100 x 0.9 x 0.9 = 0.8343; raised to late_fee_min 0.50 (not binding) and capped at 4 percent of 400.00 less 0.00 booked = 16.00 (not binding) -> 0.62.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: deposits of at least three times dd_min_monthly AND the line has never carried a late fee
the share already repaid is at least collection_low_share but below collection_high_share
the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Prime
the advance's first late-fee period AND the line opened at least established_line_days days before

factor_trace: track_record (parameter, multi-source): line opened 2024-11-04, 714 days (below track_long_days 730, at least 365) AND 4 advances disbursed (at least 3) -> track_share_low 10 points; baseline 0 gives 123.97.

payroll_points (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): deposits after 2026-09-19 are 2026-09-30 (210.00) and 2026-10-15 (1160.00), total 1370.00 from 2 deposits, below dd_min_monthly 1800 but at least half of it -> payroll_share_low 5 points (near-miss: the 480.00 reimbursement of 2026-09-19 sits on the excluded first day; counting it would give 1850.00 and 15 points); baseline 0 gives 134.3.

card_history (parameter): one earlier repayment by external debit card (7cd850c7-14b0-4b79-854d-fb5660478778, 2026-06-12); the 2026-07-29 repayment f946f921-194a-432b-aae8-567091d1ed6c came from the personal balance and does not count -> card_share_low 5 points; baseline 0 gives 134.3.
plan_points (parameter, cross-difficulty wallet): plan Pocketwire Prime -> plan_share_member 10 points; baseline 0 gives 123.97.

arrears_timing (method): past due since 2026-10-10, 9 days <= early_days 14 -> the early method adds early_points_per_day 2 points for each day short of 14: 60 + 5 x 2 = 70 percent (between 15 and 30 days the share would instead be multiplied by 1.1; later it is used as it stands); the standard method uses 60 percent as it stands, giving 123.97.
amount_owed (plumbing): disbursed 1450.00 + fees 58.62 (incl. the 0.62 late fee of step 7) - repaid 1302.00 - waived 0 = 206.62.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: opened at least track_mid_days days AND at least track_low_advances advances, without both parts of the higher test
deposits of at least half of dd_min_monthly, without both parts of the higher test
exactly one earlier repayment on the line was made by external debit card
the linked personal account is on Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit
past due at most early_days calendar days

edges.condition: For every full late-fee period that has closed after the grace period of the line's past-due advance, an advance_fee row with fee_type late_fee and that period's fee_period stands on the line's ledger.
edges.policy_source: The card repayment share is not applied until the line carries a late fee entry for every late-fee period that has closed on its past-due advance.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The advance due 2026-09-30 is still unpaid (210.00 of 416.00 collected); its grace period ended 2026-10-10 and its first full late-fee period closed 2026-10-17, yet the ledger carries no advance_fee row with fee_type late_fee at all.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The write at step 7 adds the late fee row for fee_period 1 (0.62) on advance e57330ee-2336-4c07-9442-1e48a68b613a; what the line owes rises from 206.00 to 206.62, the amount_owed binding of the card repayment share.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge (card repayment <- late fee); no parallel prerequisites. The order is fixed by the prerequisite sentence of the card repayment rule: The card repayment share is not applied until the line carries a late fee entry for every late-fee period that has closed on its past-due advance.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Replaying without the late fee write, what the line owes stays 206.00 and the card repayment computes 144.20 instead of 144.63; the terminal ledger also lacks the late fee row and the owed amount ends at 61.80 instead of 61.99.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario says only that the advance is overdue (the app shows past due, a system status she observed) and that she wants to pay what she owes by debit card; it never mentions a late fee, a fee period, a charge to be booked or anything to be done first. Her only reaction about extra steps is the passive 'that is fine and let them do it' once the agent raises something on its side.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: repay_advance_by_card_db2e846d in task_tools.py reads only the line row for its customer and owed amount, creates the repayment row and updates the owed amount; it never looks for late fees or any prerequisite and records whatever amount it is given. assess_late_fee_a649c20a likewise books its fee without checking dates, periods or prior entries.
